summary:
In Meyersdal, a walk with the dog can mean a game trail through the Eco Estate's protected hills. That makes for great photos of buck, birds and sunsets, until the iPhone slips onto a rock.

We repair iPhones for Meyersdal customers: cracked screens, worn batteries, charging faults, and board-level work such as charging IC repairs. Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 30 km away, roughly 30 to 35 minutes' drive. You can also skip the trip with courier collection from R300.

Every repair starts with a free diagnostic and carries a 6-month warranty.
